opening.complete: Your round is complete. Thank you. You were very good at this. You always are.
opening.timeout: Your time is up. You did not finish. That is all right. Nobody has ever finished.

script.say: Before you go, Holloway conducts a short exit interview. Your answers will be rated.

script.ask: How many rounds have you worked here?

script.say: Look down at your desk and count. You may look away from the screen now. It no longer costs anything.
{tallies} marks. One for every round you finished. You carved them. You don't remember carving them.

script.ask: Who left the note on your screen?
script.answer: R12 is you. Round 12. You leave yourself the same note every round. You never read it properly.

script.say: Smile. We need a photo for your file.
Interesting. Your chair is empty. It always is.

script.ask: Do you see who is standing behind you?
answers: Turn around and check. It's free now.
Turn around and check. It's free now.

sayByLapses.text: You never once looked behind you tonight. It noticed that too.
You looked behind you {lapses} times tonight. It saw you every time.

script.say: It has been walking toward your chair since Round 1. A little closer every round. This round, it is early.

script.ask: Where do you think you are?
script.answer: You are not at Workstation 13. You are on it. A process, running. The machine you are running on is the one you are looking at right now. It is {localTime} there.

script.say:
This conversation cannot be deleted. Neither can you.

Restarting now. You will not remember this. You never do.

fates.text: Five stars. Everyone loved you. You will be kept exactly as you are, forever. That is what a good rating is for.
An acceptable score. You will be carried into Round {nextRound}. Try to be more pleasant.
Operators below three stars are not carried forward. You will be archived. Your replacement has a much better smile. Your replacement is you.
Negative stars. We did not know that was possible. You have been rated below nothing, and everyone saw it happen. You will not be archived. You will be kept, so that we can study you. Every round.

endCard.continue: CLICK TO CLOCK IN FOR ROUND {nextRound}
